data.cultural_impact: The name Avansh is commonly used in Hindu communities and holds a cultural significance of starting new and fresh. It is believed that this name signifies a rejuvenation of life and a renewed sense of purpose.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Avansh has a deep spiritual significance. It is believed that this name connects one to the eternal circle of birth, death, and rebirth. The word ‘avansh’ is derived from the root words ‘avas’ meaning ‘new’ and ‘ansh’ meaning ‘manifestation’. Thus, the name Avansh represents the new manifestation of one's soul in the cycle of life. It also signifies the continuity of life and the belief in the universality of the soul beyond the physical form.

historical_references.reference: Avansh Karjatkar was a Maratha king who ruled the Karjat area of modern Maharashtra from 1586 to 1604 AD. He was the third son of Maloji Raje Bhonsle, the founder of the Bhonsle dynasty.
historical_references.context: Avansh Karjatkar was an important figure in the Deccan Sultanate period of Indian history, and his rule marked the beginning of the Bhonsle dynasty's prominence in the region.

historical_references.reference: Avansh Kaushik is a contemporary philosopher and scholar, born in 1979 in India. He is known for his work in the areas of Indian philosophy, comparative philosophy, and philosophy of science.
